hypothesis: On unseen Bemis–Murcko scaffold groups within AqSolDB V1, the frozen structure-only model improves held-out MAE over the training-label median by at least 0.25 logS, with the lower bound of a 95% group bootstrap interval above zero.

eligibility.method: Reject invalid SMILES, multiple fragments, structures without rings, non-finite labels and potential stereochemistry marked unspecified or unknown. Exclude every occurrence of a repeated canonical isomeric identity. Preserve original CSV row order after exclusions.

split.method: Single-pass whole-scaffold greedy assignment in SHA-256 byte order, with scaffold as the tie-break. Admit a group only when it strictly reduces distance from the row target and keeps holdout at or below the row cap.

bootstrap.method: Sort held-out groups, sample the same number of groups with replacement, retain all rows per sampled group, use a row-weighted paired MAE delta and the linear 2.5th/97.5th percentiles.

controls.method: NumPy default_rng(seed).permutation of training labels, identical candidate fit and held-out inputs, strict comparison on holdout MAE.

execution.dispatcher: not applicable, MR-019 permits Iris only

limits: Benchmark on the deposited heterogeneous measurements, within this release and frozen split.
